dossiers.thesis_summary: Merger-arb: long AXTA into the all-stock AkzoNobel merger-of-equals (each AXTA -> 0.6539 AkzoNobel ordinary shares; AkzoNobel separately pays a EUR2.5B pre-completion distribution to ITS holders that AXTA holders do NOT receive). Corrected implied deal value ~$34.80 vs spot ~$32.3-32.8 = ~$2.0-2.5 gross spread (~6-7%). Binding merger agreement, SEC F-4 effective 6/23/26, shareholder votes 8/5/26, close guided end-2026/early-2027 pending ~30-country antitrust.
dossiers.kill_risk: Floating stock-for-stock value: the target drifts daily with AKZO's EUR price and EURUSD, so an unhedged long-AXTA book carries AKZO/coatings + euro beta rather than a locked spread (a properly hedged arb shorts 0.6539 AKZO). Compounding: multi-jurisdiction antitrust (~30 countries incl EU/China) could force divestitures or slip close into 2027, and the net spread is thin (~$2.0-2.5, ~6-7%) so a modest AKZO drawdown or FX move erases the edge. Aug 5 vote itself is low-risk (board-recommended MoE).

dossiers.thesis_summary: DURAVYU (vorolanib insert) Phase 3 wet-AMD topline — LUGANO (NCT06668064) — is a real, unfired, idiosyncratic binary readout: average change in BCVA at weeks 52/56 vs on-label aflibercept, non-inferiority design, ~400 pts, resolving on its own trial data (not the tape). Guided "beginning mid-2026," registry primary completion Aug-2026, so realistic topline window is Aug–Oct 2026 with twin LUCIA (NCT06682?/NCT06683742) to follow. Win price ~$37.50 (supported by $33 median analyst target) vs a cash-anchored downside ~$3.00. Honest win probability is ~0.42, NOT the board's 0.60: the bull's central "strictly more favorable Phase 3" anchor is false — LUGANO enrolls both treatment-naive and previously-treated eyes, whereas the enabling Phase 2 (DAVIO-2) was previously-treated ONLY, so DURAVYU has zero Phase 2 non-inferiority evidence in the naive, higher-VEGF-burden segment — the exact population where Kodiak's KSI-301 missed NI in DAZZLE.
dossiers.kill_risk: The population-expansion problem may not just shave win-prob — it can push true success toward the market-implied ~0.30–0.35, at which point edge collapses to noise: at p=0.35, EV = 0.35x37.5 + 0.65x3.0 = $15.08 vs a ~$14.2 tape (~6%), on an UNFLOORED overnight-gap binary (loss ~-79%, no stop can catch it). Two live negatives compound the population risk: (1) DURAVYU itself MISSED its Phase 2 primary endpoint in the PAVIA NPDR trial (topline May-2024) — the drug's record is not clean; (2) per the Q1-2026 10-Q (skeptic-cited Note 8; I could not independently re-verify — SEC EDGAR 403'd and the 8-K carried no ATM detail), management drew ~$5.7M on its live ATM at ~$14.75 in Apr–May 2026, i.e. sold equity into its own binary. Modest raise vs $223M cash, but it inverts the bull's "no dilution ahead of print" tell.

Event is binding but the date is soft/company-controlled.

dossiers.thesis_summary: The forced-seller catalyst is FIRED and favourably resolved. On 2026-07-16 Uber launched a EUR41.50/share cash offer for Delivery Hero (~$14.8bn) and Prosus gave an irrevocable undertaking to tender its residual ~16.8% stake, ending the EC-mandated forced-divestment overhang that was the entire premise. Prior tranches already cleared favourably (~4.5% to Uber 17 Apr; 5% to Aspex in May). The edge is spent: the incremental value to Prosus NAV from the Uber price above the live DH mark is ~EUR0.07/share (~0.1% of NAV), not a needle-mover on an ~EUR40 stock. What remains is a structural, undated ~39% discount-to-NAV that is ~79% Tencent beta -- a value case, not an event.
dossiers.dated_milestone: 2026-10-11 (EC divestment deadline, extended from mid-Aug on 2 Jun 2026) -- but this is a risk/compliance date, not an opportunity: the catalyst already fired 2026-07-16 and Uber's offer is guided to close only H2 2027
dossiers.kill_risk: The one credible residual is wrong-signed, downside-only, and confirms FIRED rather than reviving the long: the irrevocable binds Prosus, NOT Uber. Uber's offer is conditional (50%+1 minimum acceptance, merger control + financial-regulatory clearances, BaFin approval of the offer document) and guided to close H2 2027 -- more than a year after the EC's 2026-10-11 divestment deadline. A deal break re-opens the overhang against a deadline already extended once, i.e. a short-put payoff, not special-situation upside. There is no cash backstop, CVR, or recovery value -- so the board's 'recovery' method has nothing to recover; the numbers are discount-to-NAV marks on a live Tencent-beta position, not an event floor/target.

dossiers.thesis_summary: MP Materials is the only profitable integrated US rare-earth miner/magnet maker. Its transformational idiosyncratic catalyst — the July 2025 DoD public-private partnership (equity stake, $110/kg NdPr price floor, 10-yr magnet offtake, ~$1B financing) — has ALREADY FIRED (closed July 11, 2025). Residual upside is a soft, long-dated thematic ramp: the 10X magnet campus (Northlake TX) only broke ground Q1 2026 and commissions ~2028, plus a Jan-2027 DFARS China-magnet exclusion demand pull. Day-to-day the stock trades on the rare-earth/China-export tape, not on its own datable facts. Board target $82 sits at the high end of the $65-94 Street range (consensus ~$79); $35 floor approximates the pre-DoD-deal strategic-support level.
dossiers.kill_risk: The load-bearing claim — that a live forward idiosyncratic catalyst justifies an event-driven seat — largely fails on the live record: the hard DoD catalyst fired ~1 year ago (July 2025) and the next real supply-timing milestone (10X commissioning) is 2028+, far outside a normal catalyst window. In the interim MP is a commodity/geopolitical proxy (rare-earth prices + China export policy), not an idiosyncratic special situation — it fell 15.4% in 30 days on China de-escalation headlines. A China rare-earth-export normalization is the single biggest threat to both the $82 target and the $35 floor, and it resolves on the tape, not on MP's own facts.

dossiers.dossier_note: DECK/TAPE NOTE: MP is commodity-linked (NdPr). The $82 target embeds continued elevated NdPr pricing plus a China-export-restriction scarcity premium; the DoD $110/kg NdPr floor sits well under spot and underpins the $35 downside anchor. Both axes therefore hinge on the rare-earth tape and China policy, which is why this reads as a thematic proxy rather than a Basket-13 idiosyncratic special situation. R:R math: board payoff 3.59 = (82-45.24)/(45.24-35) and ev 0.2412 = 0.45*(82/45.24-1)+0.55*(35/45.24-1) are internally consistent BUT computed off the stale $45.24. Re-marked to the live ~$54.74: payoff = (82-54.74)/(54.74-35) = 27.26/19.74 = 1.38; ev = 0.45*(82/54.74-1)+0.55*(35/54.74-1) = 0.45*0.498 + 0.55*(-0.361) = 0.224 - 0.198 = +0.026 (~+2.6%, essentially neutral). The ~+21% run since the board mark has consumed nearly all the modeled edge. Timeline: DoD deal closed 2025-07-11 (fired); 10X broke ground Q1-2026, commissions ~2028 ($1.25B, ~7,000 MT/yr magnets, +3,000 MT Independence = 10,000 MT); next earnings 2026-07-30 after close. Bottom line for the CRO/Director: the hard catalyst is spent, staging=true, and the residual thesis is a long-dated, tape-driven thematic ramp with edge already largely arbitraged away at the live price.

dossiers.thesis_summary: Olema Oncology is a single-catalyst binary: Phase 3 OPERA-01 topline data for palazestrant (oral CERAN/SERD) as monotherapy in 2/3L ER+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer, guided to fall 2026 with exact timing TBD. Confirmed real, forward-dated, unfired and idiosyncratic (resolves on trial facts, ESR1-mut + ITT populations). Binary framework: win-price ~$24, lose-floor ~$6.5, ~40% PoS; internally consistent with the board's EV. Catalyst intact — price ~$11.85 vs board's $11.47, no interim resolution.
dossiers.kill_risk: The "fall 2026" readout is a soft company-guided window (exact timing not yet announced), so it can slip into late-2026/early-2027 without invalidating the thesis — timeline drift, not deal death. Separately, the binary win/lose frame is imperfect: OPERA-01 reads out across ESR1-mutant and ITT/ESR1-WT populations, so a "win in ESR1-mut but miss/ambiguous ITT" outcome is plausible and would land between the $24 win and $6.5 floor rather than cleanly at either — the true payoff distribution has a middle mode the two-point binary understates.

dossiers.thesis_summary: DBVT is a single-binary FDA bet on the Viaskin Peanut Patch (ages 4-7). The resolving event -- the FDA approval decision -- is undated and ~Q3-Q4 2027 (more than a year out); no BLA is filed yet, so there is no acceptance, PDUFA date, or decision clock. The only near-term milestone is a company-controlled BLA filing that has already slipped from 1H 2026 to Q3 2026. At defensible axes (~$25 approval-case / ~$5 net-cash-plus-optionality floor) the ~$14.9 price implies ~49% approval odds -- market-fair, not a mispricing. Verified net cash ~$2.95/ADS with runway only 'into Q3 2027', so a dilutive raise before resolution is near-arithmetic.
dossiers.kill_risk: Floor could sit above ~$5 if the market credits residual pipeline (Viaskin Milk Ph1/2, COMFORT-toddlers sBLA planned end-2026) or a strategic bid in a peanut-fail case. And the 'undated, >1yr' framing understates a genuine ~4-month catalyst: the FDA filing-acceptance gate ~60 days after a Q3 2026 submission (~Nov-Dec 2026). The FDA 'requested no additional data' this round, so acceptance odds are non-trivial and could move the stock well before the 2027 decision.

dossiers.thesis_summary: KDP intends to separate into Beverage Co. and Global Coffee Co., with the coffee spin re-rating the two halves toward a ~$37.7 sum-of-parts vs ~$30.9 spot. The hard leg (the ~$18B JDE Peet's acquisition) already closed April 1, 2026. The residual event is the spin itself, which as of the June 23, 2026 communication is targeted for 'early 2027' (slipped from 'late 2026'), remains undated, has NO Form 10 filed, NO record date and NO effective date, and is explicitly gated on reaching 'appropriate leverage levels' and 'supportive market conditions.' Edge is a soft index-flow / conglomerate-discount re-rating, not a binding dated arb spread.
dossiers.kill_risk: The load-bearing claim — that the spin completes on a timeline and forces an SoP re-rate — has no forcing function.
